evidence.claim_scope: Programmatic read access to structured Wikidata
evidence.claim_summary: The official access guidance documents query, API and dump paths plus User-Agent, compression, concurrency and 429 backoff etiquette.

evidence.claim_locator: Who can harvest DataCite metadata? / first paragraph
evidence.claim_scope: DataCite DOI identifiers and deposited metadata in the DataCite Data File
evidence.claim_summary: DataCite states that the DOI data file is provided under a CC0 waiver for unrestricted reuse, without warranties.

evidence.claim_locator: Which DataCite APIs can I use to harvest metadata? / REST API service row
evidence.claim_scope: Findable DOI metadata retrieval through the public REST API
evidence.claim_summary: The official harvesting guide lists the REST API as available to all users, including unidentified users.
The official policy publishes identified and unidentified request tiers and requires 429-aware backoff.

evidence.claim_locator: README / license statement and Additional usage guidelines
evidence.claim_scope: Artists and artworks metadata files in the official collection repository
evidence.claim_summary: The official repository places its collection datasets in the public domain under CC0, excludes images, requests attribution and prohibits implied endorsement or misrepresentation.

evidence.claim_locator: Data Exchange Agreement / two central rules
evidence.claim_summary: Europeana publishes submitted metadata under CC0 while each digital object and preview retains its own rights statement.

evidence.claim_locator: Accessing the APIs / Get the API key
evidence.claim_summary: The official API page documents metadata access and an API-key registration path; no project credential is provisioned in this review.

evidence.claim_locator: MusicBrainz Database / Core data and Supplementary data
evidence.claim_summary: Core database data is CC0; supplementary data and live replication packets use a non-commercial share-alike license, and cover art is outside the database.

evidence.claim_locator: Frequently asked questions and Application rate limiting
evidence.claim_summary: The official API page limits free use to non-commercial access, directs commercial users to a plan or contact, and requires an identifying User-Agent and one request per second.

evidence.claim_locator: API Licensed Uses and Restrictions; Website Policies And Use of API
evidence.claim_summary: The official terms grant a revocable application license subject to registration, restrict storage and content age, prohibit unsupported automated access, and reserve ungranted rights.

evidence.claim_locator: Auction results page identity; no rights-grant locator captured
evidence.claim_summary: The official results page identifies the service, but this review did not capture an explicit machine collection, retention, transformation or commercial reuse grant.

evidence.claim_locator: About page identity; no rights-grant locator captured
evidence.claim_summary: The official page supports source identity, but no explicit data collection, storage, transformation or commercial reuse grant was captured.

evidence.claim_locator: Key Terms Related to Content; General Prohibitions
evidence.claim_summary: The official terms define proprietary and user content and general use restrictions but do not provide this review with a precise automated analytics reuse grant.

evidence.claim_locator: API Limited License and Restrictions; Prohibited Access
evidence.claim_summary: The official API terms require registration, prohibit website crawling and prohibit API collection for analytics or machine learning unless expressly authorized.

evidence.claim_locator: Content; Your Use of the Site
evidence.claim_summary: The official site terms prohibit page scraping and robots and limit downloadable product information to personal non-commercial informational use absent written consent.
The official page limits these datasets and local copies to personal and non-commercial use; commercial metadata licensing is a separate product path.

evidence.claim_locator: 429 Too Many Requests; 400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden
evidence.claim_summary: The official FAQ publishes a sub-10-requests-per-second ceiling and recommends bulk data, but this review did not capture a complete official field-level reuse license.
